title: The Golden Era Of Cheap AI Is Ending #claudecode #aitools #aiagents
description:
Claude Fable 5 just proved the cheap-AI era is closing. Investors subsidized your $20 subscription for years, but with Anthropic and OpenAI filing to go public, Fable 5 going pay-as-you-go after June 22 at double the price of Opus 4.8, and OpenAI testing ads, frontier AI is about to get expensive.

Here's how to lock in cheap AI while you still can. Get the playbook here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A_3ZtKhONWzR95dsjj9jZQBeYwwHQYnU/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true

#Shorts #AI #claude
transcript: Claude's Fable 5 has just released, and this is proof that the golden era of AI is quite literally disappearing as we know it. Think about it. For years, every time you open Claude or ChatGPT, someone else was paying for it. Anthropic and OpenAI raised billions, and that money was subsidizing your $20 subscription. You were getting thousands of dollars of tokens for the price of lunch. That is ending. Both companies just filed to go public. Anthropic on June 7th, OpenAI the very next day. And public companies have to make money. So, Fable 5 is only included in subscriptions until June 22nd. After that, it's pay as you go, and it's already double the price of Opus 4.8, the most expensive model Anthropic has ever shipped. OpenAI is testing ads inside ChatGPT. Prices are creeping up across the board. The days of cheap frontier AI are numbered, and it's not a question of if it gets more expensive, but when. So, build while you still can. Comment golden below, and I'll send you the playbook to lock in cheap AI before the deadline.
